title: HB 159 (2011-2012 (129th General Assembly)): H. B. No. 159: Elections-photographic identification
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) R.C. 3505.18(A)(1)
(quote) When an elector appears in a polling place to vote, the elector shall announce to the precinct election officials the elector's full name and current address and provide proof of the elector's identity in the form of a current and valid photo identification, a military or a nonphoto state identification, or a copy of a current utility bill, bank statement, government check, paycheck, or other government document ... that shows the name and current address of the elector card.
(section) R.C. 3501.01(AA)(4)
(quote) Is one of the following documents: (a) A valid Ohio driver's license or Ohio commercial driver's license ...; (b) A valid state identification card issued by the registrar of motor vehicles or a deputy registrar under section 4507.50 of the Revised Code ...; (c) A valid United States military identification card; or (d) A valid United States passport;
(section) R.C. 3501.01(BB)
(quote) 'Nonphoto state identification card' means a state identification card issued without a photograph pursuant to rules adopted under division (D) of section 4507.50 of the Revised Code to a person who has a religious objection to being photographed.
(b_no_id_remedy)
(section) R.C. 3505.18(A)(2)
(quote) If an elector ... does not have or is unable to provide to the precinct election officials any of the forms of identification required under division (A)(1) of this section, ... the elector may cast a provisional ballot under section 3505.181 of the Revised Code ... and do either of the following: (a) Appear at the office of the board of elections not later than the close of the polls on the day of the election and provide the identification required under division (A)(1) of this section; or (b) Write the elector's social security number, driver's license number, or state identification card number on the provisional ballot envelope, which number shall be verified by the board of elections with the bureau of motor vehicles.
(section) R.C. 3505.18(A)(4)
(quote) If an elector does not have any of the forms of identification required under division (A)(1) of this section ... a religious objection to being photographed and the elector does not have a nonphoto state identification card, the elector may execute an affirmation under penalty of election falsification ... to that effect. Upon signing the affirmation, the elector may cast a provisional ballot under section 3505.181 of the Revised Code.
(section) R.C. 4507.50(C)
(quote) Not more frequently than once every four years, an individual who does not have photo identification may apply to the registrar or a deputy registrar for the issuance to that individual of an identification card or a temporary identification card under this section without payment of any fee. The registrar shall issue photo identification to such an individual without payment of any fee described in division (A) of this section.
(section) R.C. 4507.50(D)
(quote) The bureau of motor vehicles shall promulgate rules permitting an individual with a religious objection to being photographed to receive a state identification card issued without a photograph under this section.
(c_mail_ballot_id)
(section) R.C. 3509.05(A)
(quote) the elector also shall include in the return envelope with the identification envelope a copy of the elector's current valid photo identification, or a copy of a military nonphoto state identification, or a copy of a current utility bill, bank statement, government check, paycheck, or other government document ... that shows the name and address of the elector card.
(section) R.C. 3509.03(E)
(quote) The elector's photo identification or nonphoto state identification card, or one of the following: (1) The elector's driver's license number or state identification card number; or (2) The last four digits of the elector's social security number; (3) A copy of the elector's current and valid photo identification, a copy of a military identification, or a copy of a current utility bill ...
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule)
(section) R.C. 3503.14(A)(5)
(quote) The voter to provide one or more of the following: (a) The voter's driver's license number or state identification card number, if any; (b) The last four digits of the voter's social security number, if any; (c) A copy of a current and valid photo identification, a copy of a military nonphoto state identification card, or a copy of a current utility bill, bank statement, government check, paycheck, or other government document ...
(other) R.C. 3501.01: definitions of 'photo identification' (list of qualifying documents) and 'nonphoto state identification card'
(other) R.C. 3503.14, 3503.15, 3503.16, 3503.19, 3503.24, 3503.28: registration forms, database, registration notice and challenge text updated to use the new ID terms
(other) R.C. 3505.18 / 3505.181 / 3505.182 / 3505.183: polling-place ID rule, provisional ballots, affirmation form, and which information must accompany a provisional ballot
(other) R.C. 3509.03 / 3509.031 / 3509.04 / 3509.05 / 3509.08 and 3511.02 / 3511.05 / 3511.09: absentee and in-person absentee voting, and uniformed/overseas voters, ID wording
(other) R.C. 4507.50: free state ID cards (once every four years for a person without photo ID), nonphoto state ID card for people with a religious objection, onsite ID cards for developmentally disabled applicants (effective for the February 7, 2012 special election)
(other) version: 00_IN: photo ID required at the polls (Ohio driver's license, state ID card, US military ID, US passport; current, not expired or expired after the last general election); religious-objection affirmation with provisional ballot; free ID for those who cannot afford fees
(other) version: 01_RH: same ID text as 00_IN
(other) version: 02_PH: same, plus an expired Ohio driver's license is acceptable
(other) version: 03_RS: adds nonphoto state ID card for religious objectors, expired Ohio DL or military ID acceptable, provisional-ballot cure (appear at the board by the close of polls or write SSN/DL/ID number verified with BMV), free ID once every four years for a person without photo ID, affirmation warning text
(other) note: 2011 PDF text: struck and new words are not marked. Struck words stay inline next to new ones (for example 'It shows Contains a photograph'), so quotes from 3505.18(A)(1) and 3509.05 run struck and new words together and cannot be separated by me; the title says the bill generally requires photo ID, so the utility-bill and similar options there are almost certainly struck, but I cannot confirm that from the text. The pdftotext also leaves the margin word 'Committee' in some places; I removed it from quotes. The bill did not pass the Senate (last version 03_RS). Vote mapping per brief: House passage on 01_RH (as-passed text 02_PH has the same core ID text plus the expired-license change). Amendment votes (38-58 twice, 93-1) are on floor amendments whose text I do not have.
